description: Read latest news editorial outcome after task wake

steps.name: news-after-wake
steps.script:
$f='C:\TTiTTulares\ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$l=[string](Get-Content $f -Tail 150 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'EDITORIAL RETRY|LAUNCH FAILED|LAUNCH CONFIRMED|CHAT MESSAGE CONFIRMED|CHAT LAUNCH LOG ERROR' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+(@{state='ok';last=$l.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(700,$l.Length))}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
